function.name: impl_from_IMoniker
function.description: This function returns the AntiMonikerImpl from the given IMoniker interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to represent the IMoniker interface from which the AntiMonikerImpl is to be returned.

function.return_type: AntiMonikerImpl *: Represents the AntiMonikerImpl that is returned from the given IMoniker interface.

function.name: impl_from_IROTData
function.description: This function returns a pointer to the AntiMonikerImpl structure that contains the given IROTData interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IROTData interface.

function.return_type: AntiMonikerImpl pointer, representing the AntiMonikerImpl structure that contains the IROTData interface.

function.name: is_anti_moniker
function.description: This function checks if the given IMoniker interface is an AntiMoniker and assigns the count of the AntiMoniker to the order parameter.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the IMoniker interface that is being checked.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a DWORD where the count of the AntiMoniker will be stored.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the given IMoniker interface is an AntiMoniker, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface of an AntiMoniker object. It checks if the requested interface is supported by the object and if so, returns a pointer to that interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the AntiMoniker object.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the interface pointer will be stored if the requested interface is supported.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the ppvObject is null, E_NOINTERFACE if the requested interface is not supported, or the error code returned by the function MonikerMarshal_Create or IUnknown_QueryInterface.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the AntiMonikerImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of the AntiMonikerImpl object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count of the AntiMonikerImpl object.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases the AntiMonikerImpl object, decrements the reference count, and frees the memory if the reference count is zero.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the decrement operation.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_GetClassID
function.description: This function checks if the pointer to the class identifier (CLSID) is null. If not, it assigns the CLSID of AntiMoniker to the pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pClassID
parameters.description: Pointer to the class identifier (CLSID)

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if pClassID is NULL

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_IsDirty
function.description: This function checks if the OLE-provided implementations of the IPersistStream::IsDirty method in the OLE-provided moniker interfaces have changed their internal state.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the OLE-provided moniker interfaces

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns S_FALSE indicating that the internal state never changes.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_Load
function.description: This function loads an AntiMoniker object from a stream, checks if the count is within a valid range, and assigns the count to the AntiMoniker object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface which is used to get the AntiMoniker object

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStream interface from which the AntiMoniker object is loaded

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the count is out of range, or other error codes if the IStream_Read operation fails

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_Save
function.description: This function saves an AntiMoniker object to a stream.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of the AntiMoniker object.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream where the AntiMoniker object will be saved.

parameters.name: clear_dirty
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether to clear the dirty flag after saving.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which indicates the success or failure of the operation.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_GetSizeMax
function.description: This function calculates the maximum size that the AntiMoniker object would need to save itself. It returns the size in bytes.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface object.

parameters.name: pcbSize
parameters.description: Pointer to a ULARGE_INTEGER structure that receives the size in bytes.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if pcbSize is NULL.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_BindToObject
function.description: This function is a placeholder implementation of the BindToObject method in the IMoniker interface. It currently does not provide a real implementation, but returns E_NOTIMPL to indicate that it is not implemented.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the IBindCtx interface

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface that represents the moniker to the left of this moniker

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the object

parameters.name: ppvResult
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating that the function is not implemented

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_BindToStorage
function.description: This function is used to bind to a storage using the provided parameters but is not implemented.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface used for the binding

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Binding context

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Moniker to the left of the one being bound

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier

parameters.name: ppvResult
parameters.description: Pointer to the result

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, in this case it returns E_NOTIMPL indicating the function is not implemented

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_Reduce
function.description: This function reduces the complexity of a given moniker and returns the reduced moniker. If the reduction is successful, the function returns MK_S_REDUCED_TO_SELF.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the moniker to be reduced.

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context used for moniker binding operations.

parameters.name: dwReduceHowFar
parameters.description: Specifies how far the moniker should be reduced.

parameters.name: ppmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left of the reduced moniker.

parameters.name: ppmkReduced
parameters.description: Pointer to the reduced moniker.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, the function returns MK_S_REDUCED_TO_SELF. If ppmkReduced is NULL, the function returns E_POINTER.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_ComposeWith
function.description: This function composes a new moniker by combining two existing monikers. If the fOnlyIfNotGeneric flag is set, it returns an error; otherwise, it creates a generic composite.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the first moniker

parameters.name: pmkRight
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the second moniker

parameters.name: fOnlyIfNotGeneric
parameters.description: Flag that specifies whether the function should fail if a generic composite cannot be created

parameters.name: ppmkComposite
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to the interface of the resulting composite moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns E_POINTER if ppmkComposite or pmkRight is NULL, MK_E_NEEDGENERIC if fOnlyIfNotGeneric is set, or the result of CreateGenericComposite function otherwise

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_Enum
function.description: This function checks if the ppenumMoniker pointer is null, if it is, it returns an error, otherwise it sets the value pointed by ppenumMoniker to null and returns a success code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer used in the function

parameters.name: forward
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating the direction of enumeration

parameters.name: ppenumMoniker
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IEnumMoniker interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. It returns E_INVALIDARG if ppenumMoniker is NULL, otherwise it returns S_OK

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_IsEqual
function.description: This function checks if two IMoniker interfaces are equal by comparing their counts.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: First IMoniker interface to compare

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: Second IMoniker interface to compare

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the counts are equal, S_FALSE if they are not, and E_INVALIDARG if the 'other' parameter is NULL.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_Hash
function.description: This function calculates the hash of an AntiMonikerImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface of the AntiMonikerImpl object.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD to store the calculated hash.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error code if the operation fails.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_IsRunning
function.description: This function checks if the object, identified by the provided moniker, is currently running. It uses the IBindCtx interface to get the Running Object Table (ROT) and then checks if the object is running.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the moniker that identifies the object to check.

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the bind context used to get the Running Object Table.

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Unused in this function. In other contexts, it could be used to specify a portion of a composite moniker.

parameters.name: pmkNewlyRunning
parameters.description: Unused in this function. In other contexts, it could be used to specify a moniker that has just started running.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns E_INVALIDARG if the bind context pointer is NULL, the result of IBindCtx_GetRunningObjectTable if it fails, or the result of IRunningObjectTable_IsRunning if it succeeds.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_GetTimeOfLastChange
function.description: This function is a placeholder for a function that would return the time of the last change to an AntiMoniker object. Currently, it does not implement any functionality.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to an IBindCtx interface

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pAntiTime
parameters.description: Pointer to a FILETIME structure

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating that the function is not implemented.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_Inverse
function.description: This function checks if the pointer to the IMoniker interface is null, if it is, it returns an error. Otherwise, it sets the value pointed by the interface to zero and returns an error indicating that the operation has no inverse.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: ppmk
parameters.description: Double pointer to the IMoniker interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, either success or an error code

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_CommonPrefixWith
function.description: This function compares two monikers and sets a prefix based on the comparison. It also returns a status code based on the comparison result.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: The first moniker to be compared.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: The second moniker to be compared.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: A pointer to a moniker that will be set as the common prefix.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It can be MK_S_US, MK_S_ME, or MK_S_HIM depending on the comparison of the moniker counts.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_RelativePathTo
function.description: This function checks the validity of the parameters, increases the reference count of the 'other' parameter and assigns it to the 'result' parameter, and returns a specific HRESULT value.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface moniker object.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: Pointer to another interface moniker object.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an interface moniker object, which will be assigned the value of 'other'.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. It returns E_INVALIDARG if either 'other' or 'result' is NULL, and MK_S_HIM otherwise.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_GetDisplayName
function.description: This function gets the display name of an AntiMoniker object. It allocates memory for the display name and copies the name into it. If the pmkToLeft parameter is not NULL, the function is not implemented and returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface of the AntiMoniker object

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the IBindCtx interface, used for binding operations

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface of the moniker to the left of this moniker in the composite

parameters.name: displayname
parameters.description: Pointer to the display name string

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It can return S_OK if the operation is successful, E_POINTER if the displayname is NULL, E_NOTIMPL if pmkToLeft is not NULL, or E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_ParseDisplayName
function.description: This function is a placeholder and currently not implemented. It is supposed to parse the display name of an AntiMoniker object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the AntiMoniker object

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left of the display name being parsed

parameters.name: pszDisplayName
parameters.description: Pointer to the display name to parse

parameters.name: pchEaten
parameters.description: Pointer to the number of characters parsed

parameters.name: ppmkOut
parameters.description: Pointer to the resulting parsed moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating the function is not implemented.

function.name: AntiMonikerImpl_IsSystemMoniker
function.description: This function checks if the provided moniker is a system moniker and updates the pwdMksys pointer with the MKSYS_ANTIMONIKER value if it is not null.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IMoniker interface.

parameters.name: pwdMksys
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a DWORD variable where the function stores the MKSYS_ANTIMONIKER value if the pointer is not null.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function execution. It returns E_POINTER if pwdMksys is null, otherwise it returns S_OK.

function.name: AntiMonikerROTDataImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface of the AntiMonikerImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that is being queried.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, the return value is S_OK. Otherwise, it is an error code.

function.name: AntiMonikerROTDataImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function is used to increment the reference count for an interface on an object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IROTData interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count.

function.name: AntiMonikerROTDataImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases an interface pointer to the AntiMonikerImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the AntiMonikerImpl object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the AntiMonikerImpl object after the release operation.

function.name: AntiMonikerROTDataImpl_GetComparisonData
function.description: This function gets comparison data for an AntiMoniker object. It calculates the required data size, checks if the provided buffer is large enough, and if so, copies the CLSID and count of the AntiMoniker object into the buffer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the AntiMoniker object

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the comparison data will be copied

parameters.name: data_len
parameters.description: Length of the provided buffer

parameters.name: data_req
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the function will store the required data size

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or E_OUTOFMEMORY if the provided buffer is not large enough

function.name: unsafe_impl_from_IMoniker
function.description: This function checks if the vtable of the given interface matches the vtable of AntiMonikerImpl. If it does, it returns the AntiMonikerImpl instance containing the given interface. Otherwise, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that needs to be checked and possibly cast to AntiMonikerImpl.

function.return_type: AntiMonikerImpl pointer. It represents the AntiMonikerImpl instance containing the given interface if the vtable matches, otherwise NULL.

function.name: create_anti_moniker
function.description: This function creates an AntiMoniker object and initializes its properties. It also assigns the address of this object to the second parameter.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: This parameter is used to set the 'count' property of the AntiMoniker object.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer. The address of the newly created AntiMoniker object is assigned to this pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: CreateAntiMoniker
function.description: This function creates an anti-moniker and assigns it to the provided IMoniker pointer.

parameters.name: moniker
parameters.description: A pointer to an IMoniker pointer. The function will assign the created anti-moniker to this pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns the result of the 'create_anti_moniker' function.

function.name: AntiMoniker_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of an AntiMoniker. It checks if the pUnk parameter is not null, if so it returns an error. Then it creates an AntiMoniker and queries its interface. Finally, it releases the Moniker and returns the HRESULT.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the class factory interface

parameters.name: pUnk
parameters.description: Pointer to the IUnknown interface of the aggregate

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call, success or the error that occurred
